purpose: Pin the Version 2.1 selected-snapshot schedule and whole-interval raster semantics before any admitted-raster execution.

semantics.intervalValueOne: Observed forest loss in at least one adjacent annual loss raster within the full interval.
semantics.intervalValueZero: Every adjacent annual loss raster explicitly records no loss for the cell.
semantics.intervalNoData: If no loss is observed and one or more annual rasters are nodata, retain nodata; never convert missing coverage to zero.

requiredBeforeOutput: Each input raster must be admitted and checksum-bound in the source ledger.
Each output must record input checksums, method version, code version, grid, CRS, geotransform, nodata, byte length, output checksum, coverage, and timing/resource measurements.
Boundary aggregates, tiles, downloads, citation metadata, validation, scientific review, release approval, and production admission remain separate gates.
